description.html: Superworms (Zophobas morio), size S, pack of 100 pieces. Superworms are a favorite treat rich in protein and fat, ideal for young reptiles and smaller species - young bearded dragons, leopard geckos and other insect eaters. Because of their high fat content, they are given occasionally, as a supplement to the regular diet.

Superworms have a harder exoskeleton than dubia roaches, so they are recommended for reptiles with well-developed jaws. Keep them at room temperature (not in the fridge, because low temperatures shorten their lives) with a little food such as a piece of carrot or potato to maintain moisture and for gut-loading before feeding.
